title: Efficacy and Safety of Diclofenac Sodium Gel in Hand Osteoarthritis
brief_summary: This study will test the efficacy and safety of topical diclofenac sodium gel in the treatment of hand osteoarthritis.
raw_criteria:
Key Inclusion criteria:

• Osteoarthritis of the hand

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Other rheumatic disease, such as rheumatoid arthritis
* Active gastrointestinal ulcer during the last year
* Known allergy to analgesic drugs
